blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Causal relations in disaster-related social media of- ten span independent posts, making cross-tweet causal discovery difficult to supervise and model at scale. We propose STAGE, a framework that separates scalable cross-tweet weak-supervision construction from spatio-temporal relational learning over event occurrences. Starting from local causal seeds, STAGE retrieves semantically related event occurrences across tweets and uses a causal scorer to construct weakly labeled cross-tweet pairs. These pairs supervise a multi-head Graph Attention Network over semantically enriched event representations and a spatio- temporal context graph. We evaluate STAGE on California Wildfire and Hurricane Harvey using human-gold cross-tweet test sets and 15 baselines. Compared with local-only supervision, the constructed cross-tweet supervision improves STAGE AUPRC by 0.340 on Wildfire and 0.107 on Hurricane. STAGE achieves in-domain AUROC of 0.885 on Wildfire and 0.710 on Hurricane. Cross-disaster experiments reveal asymmetric transfer, highlighting sensitivity to dataset-specific spatio-temporal shifts. These results demonstrate the value of scalable cross-tweet supervision combined with relational event modeling for causal learning across fragmented disaster reports.
blocks.zh: 灾害相关社交媒体中10个跨度的独立帖子的因果关系,使得交叉调频因果发现难以进行大规模监督和建模. 我们提议STAGE,一个框架,将可伸缩的跨微弱的超视觉构建与斯皮提奥-时空关系学习区分开来。 从本地因果种子开始,STAGE在微博上检索了与事件相关的事件,并使用因果计分器来构建贴有微弱标签的交叉对子. 这些对子监督一个多头图注目网络,监督内容精密丰富的事件表述和时空图。 我们用人体金色的横纹测试机和15个基线 来评估加州野火和飓风哈维的STAGE 与仅在当地进行的监管相比,建造的交叉式监管使STAGE AUPRC在野火上改善0.340,飓风上改善0.107. STAGE实现域内AUROC0.885对野火,0.710对飓风. 跨灾害实验揭示了不对称的转移,突出了对数据集特异性时空转移的敏感性. 这些结果表明,可伸缩的交叉微调监督以及关系事件模型对分散的灾害报告进行因果学习的价值。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Discovering causal relationships in social media presents a fundamental challenge, particularly for understanding how real-world events unfold and escalate during disasters. Traditional causal extraction methods are fundamentally limited for uncovering causal chains in social media streams because they operate on isolated text units. Sentence-level approaches rely on explicit linguistic cues that are rare in informal tweets. Neural and LLM-based models capture semantic associations but may conflate them with causation due to a lack of structural grounding [ 1 ] . Meanwhile, cross-document event linking methods such as Zhao et al. [ 2 ] rely on richer document-level context, while knowledge-augmented approaches may depend on retrieved evidence [ 3 ] or structured event graphs [ 4 ] , making them difficult to apply directly to noisy, fragmented, and high-volume disaster streams. Figure 1 illustrates this cross-tweet setting, where a causal relation connects specific event occurrences described in different tweets rather than the tweets as whole units.
blocks.zh: 在社交媒体中发现因果关系是一个根本性的挑战,特别是在了解灾害期间现实世界事件的发生和升级方面。 传统的因果提取方法对于在社交媒体流中发现因果链来说根本是有限的,因为它们在孤立的文本单元上运行. 句子层面的方法依赖于在非正式微博中罕见的明确的语言提示. 基于神经和LLM的模型能捕捉语义关联,但可能由于缺乏结构地基而与因果关系相混淆 [1]. 同时,交叉文件事件将赵等方法联系起来. [2] 依赖更丰富的文件层面背景,而知识强化的方法则可能依赖于取回的证据[3]或结构化事件图表[4],使其难以直接适用于吵闹、支离破碎和大量灾害流。 图1说明了这种交叉推特设置,其中因果关系连接了不同推文中描述的具体事件,而不是整个推特单位.

blocks.en: The core challenge is therefore to move beyond single-text analysis and develop a method that can connect causal information distributed across posts while exploiting the spatio-temporal structure of an unfolding disaster. An effective solution should not rely solely on explicit textual markers, but should also exploit temporal, spatial, and semantic context when reasoning about relations between specific events. We introduce STAGE (Spatio-Temporal Augmented Graph Expansion), a framework that combines scalable cross-tweet weak supervision with spatio-temporal relational learning. STAGE constructs weakly supervised cross-tweet event pairs and models them through an event graph grounded in three complementary signals: (1) temporal information that captures temporal proximity and reporting context, (2) geographic information that captures spatial relationships among events, and (3) semantically enriched event representations that bridge lexical variation across posts.
blocks.zh: 因此,核心挑战是超越单行本分析,开发一种方法,在利用正在发生的灾害的时空结构的同时,将各员额的因果信息联系起来。 有效的解决办法不应仅仅依靠明确的文字标记,还应在对具体事件之间的关系进行推理时利用时间、空间和语义背景。 我们引入了STAGE(Spatio-Temperal Advanced Graph Explosion),这个框架将可伸缩的交叉微弱监管与斯皮蒂奥-时空关系学习相结合. STAGE通过基于三个互补信号的事件图构建了受弱监督的相交事件对并模拟它们:(1) 时间信息能捕捉时间相近和报告背景;(2) 地理信息能捕捉事件之间的空间关系;(3) 模拟丰富事件表述能弥合各站点的词汇差异。

blocks.zh: 发相. 1:交叉推倒因果关系的典型例子. 每条微博描述多个事件实例,而突出显示的关系将Tweet A描述的特定事件与Tweet B描述的特定事件相连接.

blocks.en: In this work, we use causal discovery in the task-specific sense of identifying directed causal relations between real-world event instances described across social media posts. The prediction unit is an ordered pair of event occurrences, each representing a specific event instance described in a particular tweet. A cross-tweet pair therefore consists of two occurrences drawn from different tweets, and the prediction determines whether one causes the other and, if so, in which direction. This formulation enables event-level reasoning rather than treating entire tweets as causal units.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们用因果发现来从特定任务的角度来识别各个社交媒体文章所描述的真实世界事件之间的直接因果关系. 预测单位是一对按顺序排列的事件发生地,每个事件代表特定微博所描述的具体事件. 因此一对相通的对由来自不同推特的两起事件组成,而预测则决定了其中一起是否造成另一起,如果造成另一起,则由哪个方向产生. 这种表述使得事件层面的推理成为可能,而不是将整个推文视为因果关系单位.

blocks.en: The framework separates cross-tweet supervision construction from spatio-temporal graph learning. Cross-tweet candidate pairs are first generated from semantic neighborhoods defined by event triggers and arguments, without temporal or spatial constraints, providing the basis for scalable weak supervision. STAGE then combines semantic, temporal, and spatial information, applies semantic expansion across related event descriptions, and constructs a graph whose contextual edges capture spatio-temporal relationships. A Graph Attention Network propagates information over this structure before predicting causal existence and direction for ordered event pairs. Thus, temporal and spatial information contribute to causal learning without determining which pairs enter the candidate pool. Our contributions are threefold: • We propose STAGE, a framework for cross-tweet causal discovery that separates scalable cross-tweet supervision construction from spatio-temporal relational learning over event occurrences. • We introduce a scalable weak-supervision strategy for cross-tweet causal learning in which candidate event pairs are constructed from trigger-and-argument semantic neighborhoods and assigned weak causal labels by a fixed causal scorer, while human-gold pairs are withheld from model training and reserved for evaluation. • We instantiate the relational learner with a spatio-temporal event graph and multi-head GAT, and evaluate the framework under in-domain weak supervision, local-to-cross-tweet generalization, cross-disaster transfer, and component ablations.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Causal Discovery in Natural Language
blocks.zh: II-A 自然语言的因果关系

blocks.en: Early causal extraction relied on lexical and syntactic patterns [ 5 ] , semantic parsing for causal questions [ 6 ] , and feature-based classifiers using dependency and lexical cues [ 7 ] , with resources such as SemEval-2010 Task 8 supporting supervised relation learning [ 8 ] . Later work incorporated external structure and data augmentation: LSIN uses induced descriptive and relational graphs [ 9 ] , while knowledge-guided augmentation [ 10 ] and prompt-based auxiliary objectives [ 11 ] improve event causality identification. Furthermore, recent methods increasingly model richer event interactions. SemDI formulates event causality as semantic dependency inquiry [ 12 ] ; ICCL uses contrastive demonstrations [ 13 ] ; iLIF iteratively constructs and exploits an event causality graph [ 14 ] ; and GLM4ECI evaluates LLM-generated statements for directional event causality identification [ 15 ] . More recently, Su et al. propose a suggest–verify–revise framework with structural refinement for document-level causality [ 16 ] . These methods advance event causality identification, but primarily operate within sentences or coherent documents, whereas disaster tweets are short, noisy, and may distribute causal evidence across independent posts.
blocks.zh: 早期的因果提取依赖于词学和合成模式 [5],语义解析因果问题 [6],以及基于特征的分类器使用依赖和词典提示 [7],资源如SemEval-2010任务8支持有监督的关系学习 [8]. 后来的工作包括外部结构和数据扩充: LSIN使用诱导描述和关系图[9],而由知识引导的增强[10]和即时的辅助目标[11]改进了事件因果关系的识别. 此外,最近的方法越来越多地模拟更丰富的事件互动。 SemDI将事件因果关系表述为语义依赖性调查[12];ICCL使用对比性演示[13];iLIF迭代构造和利用事件因果关系图[14];GLM4ECI评价LLM生成的语句用于定向事件因果关系识别[15]. 近来, Su等人提出了对文件一级因果关系进行结构改进的建议----核实----修订框架[16]。 这些方法推进事件因果关系的识别,但主要在句子或连贯的文件中运作,而灾难的微博短而吵闹,可能通过独立帖子分发因果关系证据.

blocks.en: II-B Weak Supervision for Event and Relation Learning
blocks.zh: II-B 对事件和关系学习的监督薄弱

blocks.en: Weak supervision reduces annotation cost by deriving labels from indirect signals. Snorkel combines heuristic labeling functions through a probabilistic label model [ 17 ] , while distant supervision aligns textual mentions with knowledge-base relations to construct large weakly labeled corpora [ 18 ] . For event relations, Yao et al. derive weak temporal labels from ordering regularities [ 19 ] , while Mirroshandel and Ghassem-Sani infer temporal relations using bootstrapping and expectation maximization over clustered documents [ 20 ] . Nath et al. study cross-document event coreference using semantic transfer and multimodal ensembles [ 21 ] , and a recent survey identifies weak supervision as an important direction for scalable event causality learning [ 22 ] . These studies demonstrate the value of indirect supervision, but semantic or temporal correspondence does not by itself establish causality. Therefore, STAGE uses semantic correspondence to construct candidate cross-tweet event pairs and introduces temporal and spatial information separately during relational learning.
blocks.zh: 监管不力通过从间接信号中取出标签来降低注释成本. Snockel通过概率标签模型[17]结合了Heuristic标签功能,而远程监管则将文本提及与知识-基础关系相协调来构建被弱标签的大公司[18]. 对于事件关系, 姚等编. 从命令的规律中得出了微弱的时间标签[19],而Mirroshandel和Ghassem-Sani则通过靴子束缚和期望最大化来推断时间关系。 纳特等. 利用语义转移和多模式组合研究跨文件事件相互参照[21],最近的一项调查确定,薄弱的监督是可扩展事件因果关系学习的一个重要方向[22]。 这些研究证明了间接监督的价值,但语义或时间性通信本身并不能确定因果关系. 因此,STAGE使用语义通信来构建候选相交事件对并,并在关系学习期间分别引入时空信息.

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Overview of the STAGE framework. Extracted event representations support both cross-tweet weak supervision, where semantically retrieved candidate pairs are scored and aggregated into weak causal labels with directions assigned to causal pairs, and spatio-temporal graph construction and semantic expansion. A multi-head GAT then learns contextualized event representations for directed causal prediction across tweets.

blocks.en: II-C Cross-Document and Cross-Tweet Event Linking
blocks.zh: II-C 交叉文件和交叉互联活动

blocks.en: Cross-document event research links event mentions across texts using semantic and structural evidence. Min et al. combine local and global reasoning for cross-document event coreference [ 23 ] , while Xu et al. use heterogeneous graph interactions for document-level event extraction [ 24 ] . Yao et al. introduce argument-centric causal intervention to reduce spurious reliance on lexical similarity in cross-document event coreference [ 25 ] . Multi-document event extraction has also combined large and small language models to connect heterogeneous documents [ 26 ] .
blocks.zh: 跨文件事件研究链接事件提及跨文本使用语义和结构证据. Min等编. 将本地和全局的逻辑结合起来,以便交叉文件事件相互参照[23],同时 许等. 在文档级别事件提取时使用多种图形交互[24]。 姚等引入以论证为核心的因果干预,以减少跨文件事件共参考中虚假地依赖词汇相似性[25]. 多文件事件提取还结合了大小语言模型,连接了多文件[26].

blocks.en: In social-media settings, Dong et al. analyze cascading disaster effects using textual and geospatial signals [ 27 ] , while Lenti et al. model probable causal drivers of climate activism from Reddit and external events [ 28 ] . However, these settings differ from explicit event-occurrence-level causal prediction across independent tweets. Our prior CaST framework studies spatio-temporal event causality within tweets and identifies cross-tweet causal reasoning as an open direction due to the absence of cross-tweet annotations [ 29 ] . STAGE addresses this gap by constructing cross-tweet supervision and learning relations between event occurrences distributed across posts.
blocks.zh: 在社交媒体环境中, 董等编. 利用文字和地理空间信号分析连带灾害效应[27],而Lenti等人则认为, 模拟来自Reddit和外部事件的气候活动可能因果因素[28]。 然而,这些设置不同于独立微博上对事件-发生率的明显因果关系预测。 我们之前的 CaST 框架研究了微博中的spatio-timperal事件因果关系,并认定交叉tweet因果推理是由于缺乏交叉tweet说明[29]的开放方向. STAGE通过建立相互监督和学习关系来解决这一差距。

blocks.en: II-D Knowledge-Augmented and LLM-Based Causal Reasoning
blocks.zh: II-D 知识强化和基于LLM的因果关系

blocks.en: External knowledge and language models provide additional mechanisms for causal reasoning. Knowledge-graph methods exploit graph structure to infer missing relations [ 30 ] , while retrieval-augmented generation introduces retrieved evidence into pretrained language models [ 3 ] . Kiciman et al. show that LLMs can perform several forms of causal reasoning [ 31 ] , although evaluation on causal extraction tasks continues to reveal limitations in complex real-world text [ 32 ] .
blocks.zh: 外部知识和语言模型为因果推理提供了额外的机制. 知识-图法利用图表结构推断出缺失的关系[30],而取回-被取回的生成将取回的证据引入了预先训练的语言模型[3]. 克西曼等编. 显示LLMS可以进行几种形式的因果推理[31],尽管对因果提取任务的评价继续揭示出复杂现实世界文本中的局限性[32].

blocks.en: Structural guidance can improve such reasoning. Long et al. use language models as imperfect experts for causal discovery [ 33 ] , while Roy et al. use Causal Event Graphs to support language-based spatio-temporal reasoning [ 4 ] . SERE retrieves structurally relevant demonstrations for LLM-based event causality identification [ 34 ] , and Zhao et al. introduce potential-outcome and actual-causality grounding to mitigate causal bias in LLMs [ 35 ] . These approaches demonstrate the value of external structure, but large-scale disaster streams require causal learning over fragmented posts without depending on curated knowledge bases or repeated LLM inference.
blocks.zh: 结构指导可以改进这种推理。 龙等. 使用语言模型作为不完美的专家进行因果发现[33],而Roy等. 使用 Causal Evention Graphs 支持基于语言的时空推理 [4]. SERE为基于LLM的事件因果关系识别检索了结构上相关的演示[34],而赵等. 引入潜在结果和实际因果关系基础,以缓解法学硕士课程中的因果关系[35]。 这些方法显示了外部结构的价值,但大规模的灾害流需要因果学习,而不是依靠经过整理的知识基础或重复的LLM推断。

blocks.en: Manually annotating cross-tweet causal relations at disaster-stream scale is impractical because the number of possible event-occurrence pairs grows rapidly with the number of extracted events. blocks.en: We evaluate STAGE on two disaster-related social media corpora: California Wildfire (Wildfire) and Hurricane Harvey (Hurricane). Wildfire spans November 7 to December 1, 2018, whereas Hurricane spans August 26 to August 31, 2017. Although the two corpora contain comparable amounts of social-media data, Hurricane is substantially more temporally concentrated. Table I summarizes the main dataset and weak-supervision statistics.

Seed-conditioned semantic retrieval generates cross-tweet candidate pairs, which are subsequently evaluated by the causal scorer and aggregated into the weak-supervision pools. Candidate and weak-supervision counts in Table I refer to unique event pairs. The human-gold evaluation sets are kept separate from the weak supervision used to train STAGE. blocks.en: To construct the human-gold evaluation sets, we sample 10,000 event pairs from the full cross-tweet candidate pool of each disaster and manually annotate them. Each pair is assigned one of five substantive labels: A-Causes-B , B-Causes-A , Related-Noncausal , Same-Event , or Unrelated ; pairs for which a reliable judgment cannot be made are marked Uncertain . For binary causal evaluation, A-Causes-B and B-Causes-A are mapped to the causal class, while Related-Noncausal , Same-Event , and Unrelated are mapped to the non-causal class. Uncertain cases are excluded from evaluation. The resulting gold sets contain 3,609 causal Wildfire pairs (36.73%) and 3,964 causal Hurricane pairs (42.14%); their total usable sizes are reported in Table I . All human-gold pairs are removed from the candidate pool before constructing the weak-supervision training and development sets and are used only for final evaluation. Consequently, the evaluation measures causal prediction within the retrieved candidate space and does not quantify causal relations missed by candidate generation.

blocks.en: IV-C Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 四-C 评价计量

blocks.en: We evaluate causal-existence prediction using Precision, Recall, F1, area under the precision–recall curve (AUPRC), and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). We treat AUPRC as the primary threshold-independent metric because causal pairs form the minority class and the precision–recall curve directly reflects the trade-off between recovering causal relations and introducing false causal links. AUROC is reported as a complementary measure of overall class separability. Precision, Recall, and F1 characterize performance at the causal decision threshold selected on the development set and fixed before evaluation on the human-gold test set. We additionally report Direction Accuracy (DirAcc) among human-gold causal pairs that are predicted as causal. DirAcc is the proportion of these detected causal pairs for which the predicted cause–effect direction matches the human annotation, separating direction selection from causal-existence recall. Recall is not ranked independently, since high recall can result from over-predicting the causal class.
blocks.zh: 我们使用精准、回召、F1、精准-回召曲线下的区域(AUPRC)和接收器操作特征曲线下的区域(AUROC)来评估因果关系预测。 我们把AUPRC作为主要的阈值独立衡量标准,因为因果对组成了少数类,而精度-召回曲线直接反映了恢复因果关系与引入假因果联系之间的取舍。 报告AUROC是衡量整体分类可分性的补充措施。 精度,回想,和F1在开发集所选择的因果决定阈值上描述性能,并在对人-金测试集进行评价前固定. 此外,我们还报告在预计为因果的人类-黄金因子对中的定向精确性(DirAcc)。 DirAcc是这些被检测到的因果对的比例,预测的因果方向与人的注释相匹配,将方向选择与因果存在召回区分开来. 召回不是独立排列的,因为高召回可能是因果类的过度预测造成的.

blocks.en:
After removing all human-gold pairs, we construct event-disjoint training and development splits from the remaining weak-supervision pool so that an event occurrence cannot contribute supervision to both partitions; a pair is retained only when both endpoints belong to the same partition. Wildfire contains 454,369 training and 8,776 development pairs, with causal rates of 32.02% and 30.52%, respectively. Hurricane contains 404,351 training and 7,730 development pairs, with causal rates of 19.64% and 19.00%.
We use crisistransformers/CT-M2-Complete as the semantic encoder with maximum input length 192 and encoding batch size 128. Semantic expansion retrieves the top q = 3 q=3 related events. Temporal and spatial graph connections are restricted to 12 hours and 150 km, respectively, with at most eight temporal and eight spatial neighbors per event. Two-hop neighborhoods are sampled with fanouts [ 20 , 10 ] [20,10] .
The GAT uses hidden dimension 256, eight attention heads, and dropout 0.1. Training uses batch size 128 and AdamW with learning rate 5 × 10 − 3 5\times 10^{-3} , weight decay 10 − 5 10^{-5} , and focal-loss focusing parameter γ = 2 \gamma=2 . All models are trained for 15 epochs using multiple random seeds, and we report the mean performance across runs. For each run, the checkpoint with highest development-set AUPRC is retained. Experiments are conducted on an Intel Core i9-13950HX processor, 64 GB RAM, and an NVIDIA RTX 5000 Ada Generation Laptop GPU with 16 GB memory.

blocks.en: STAGE achieves the highest AUROC (0.885) and second-highest AUPRC (0.828), while its F1 is effectively tied with BiLSTM+Attention (0.752 versus 0.753). This indicates strong causal/non-causal separation, although STAGE does not uniformly outperform the strongest text-only baseline. Several baselines perform near chance in the fragmented cross-tweet setting, including ANM, DECI, PPAT, CHEER, and SemDI (AUROC 0.481–0.598). These methods label 72%–100% of test pairs as causal, which drives recall toward 1 but reduces precision toward the causal-class prevalence in Fig. 4 a, keeping their F1 (at most 0.552) close to the all-positive reference of 0.537.
blocks.zh: STAGE实现最高的AUROC(0.885)和第二高的AUPRC(0.828),而其F1则与BiLSTM+Attenting(0.752比0.753)有效捆绑. 这表明存在强烈的因果关系/非因果关系分离,尽管STAGE没有统一地超过最强的文本基准。 几个基线在零散的相交式布局中几乎是偶然的,包括ANM、DECI、PPAT、CHEER和SemDI(AUROC 0481-0.598)。 这些方法将72-100%的测试对标为因果, 这驱使人们回想起1, 却降低了因果类流行的精确度。 4a,使其F1(最多为0.552)接近于0.537的全阳性参考.

blocks.en: STAGE and the strongest baselines show lower causal-ranking performance on Harvey, consistent with its denser event stream, stronger class imbalance, and noisier weak labels. STAGE ranks second in both AUPRC (0.620) and AUROC (0.710), behind BERT (0.626 and 0.723) and marginally ahead of BiLSTM+Attention (0.616 and 0.709). STAGE has the highest precision of all methods (0.676) but also the lowest recall (0.333), which yields an F1 of 0.446, below the all-positive reference. The low F1 reflects the operating threshold more than ranking quality. The decision threshold λ \lambda is selected on weak-labeled development data, and the causal rate of Harvey’s weak training pairs (19.64%) is less than half that of the human-gold pairs (42.14%). STAGE labels 20.8% of Hurricane test pairs as causal, close to the training prior, so its errors are predominantly missed causal pairs rather than spurious causal edges (Fig. 4 b).
blocks.zh: STAGE和最强的基线显示哈维的因果排名较低,符合其更密集的事件流,更强烈的阶级不平衡,以及噪声弱标签. STAGE在AUPRC(0.620)和AUROC(0.710)中排名第二,落后于BERT(0.626和0.723),略高于BiLSTM+Attention(0.616和0.709)。 STAGE是所有方法中最精确的(0.676),但也是最低的召回(0.333),其F1值为0.446,低于所有正比分. 低F1比排名质量更能反映操作阈值. 而哈维的弱训练对对(19.64%)的因果率还不到人金对(42.14%)的一半。 STAGE将20.8%的飓风测试对标为因果,接近前期训练,因此其出错主要是错失了因果对而不是假因果边缘(图4b).

blocks.en: Conditional on detecting a causal pair, STAGE predicts its direction correctly in 99.1% of Wildfire cases and 99.6% of Hurricane cases. This is consistent with the high directional agreement between weak and human-gold labels in Table II , suggesting that most remaining difficulty lies in determining whether a causal relation exists rather than in orienting an identified causal pair.
blocks.zh: STAGE在发现一对因果对时,在99.1%的"野火"病例和99.6%的"飓风"病例中,其方向预测正确. 这与表二中弱标签和人金标签之间的高度方向性一致是一致的,这表明剩下的大多数困难在于确定是否存在因果关系,而不是确定一个已查明的因果关系。

blocks.en: V-B Cross-Tweet Versus Local Supervision
blocks.zh: V-B 十字花样Versus地方监督

blocks.en: Trained only on local within-tweet causal supervision, STAGE generalizes poorly to cross-tweet pairs (Table IV , left). Its AUPRC is 0.488 on Wildfire and 0.513 on Hurricane (sixth and eighth of 16), and it labels most cross-tweet pairs as causal (recall 0.945 and 0.933). The strongest results in this setting come from text-only models: RF (0.552 AUPRC) and ICCL (0.702 AUROC) on Wildfire, and KnowQA (0.587 AUPRC, 0.697 AUROC) on Harvey. Local supervision contains no labeled causal relation whose endpoints occur in different tweets, so STAGE receives no direct supervision for cross-tweet causal decisions.
blocks.zh: STAGE只接受过局部内接因果监督培训,一般不善于交叉对接(表四,左)。 其AUPRC为"野火"0.488级和"飓风"0.513级(16分之六和8),并标注了大多数相交对为"因果"(召回0.945和0.933)。 这种设定中最强的结果来自只使用文字的模型:野火上的RF(0.552 AUPRC)和ICCL(0.702 AUROC),哈维上的KnowQA(0.587 AUPRC,0.697 AUROC). 本地监管没有包含标签因果关系,其端点出现在不同的推特上,因此STAGE没有直接监管交叉推特因果关系决定.

blocks.en: Fig. 5: AUROC of STAGE and baselines across the six evaluation settings.
blocks.zh: 图5:6个评价环境的动态和基线。

blocks.en: Replacing local supervision with the constructed cross-tweet weak supervision reverses this picture (Fig. 5 ). STAGE improves by + 0.340 +0.340 AUPRC and + 0.270 +0.270 AUROC on Wildfire and by + 0.107 +0.107 AUPRC and + 0.108 +0.108 AUROC on Harvey, the largest AUPRC gain of any method on both datasets. The supervision also benefits the baselines, with median AUPRC gains of + 0.14 +0.14 on Wildfire and + 0.03 +0.03 on Harvey. These results indicate that the constructed cross-tweet supervision provides useful learning signal independently of the downstream architecture, while STAGE can additionally exploit that signal through relational modeling.
blocks.zh: 用已建起的交叉式薄弱监督取代地方监督,扭转了这一局面(图5)。 STAGE在野火上改进了+0.340+0.340 AUPRC和+0.270 AUROC在野火上改进了+0.107+0.107 AUPRC和+0.108 AUROC在哈维上改进了+0.140+0.340 AUPRC,这是AUPR在两个数据集上取得的任何方法的最大收益. 监督也有利于基线,AUPRC的中位收益为:野火+0.14+0.14;哈维+0.03+0.03. 这些结果表明,所构建的交叉调制监督独立于下游建筑提供了有用的学习信号,而STAGE则可以通过关系模型来进一步利用该信号.

blocks.en: V-C Cross-Disaster Transfer
blocks.zh: V-C 跨灾害转移

blocks.en: Transferring from Wildfire to Harvey, STAGE achieves the best AUPRC (0.582) and AUROC (0.675) of all methods, ahead of BiLSTM+Attention (0.562 AUPRC) and ICCL (0.668 AUROC). It loses only 0.038 AUPRC relative to in-domain training on Harvey, whereas BERT, which has the highest in-domain Hurricane AUPRC and AUROC, loses 0.118 (0.626 to 0.508). Several baselines collapse toward a single class under this shift: BERT, DAPrompt, iLIF, and RCE recover fewer than 9% of causal pairs, while ANM, DECI, and CHEER label nearly all pairs as causal.
blocks.zh: 从野火转移到哈维,STAGE在所有方法中都取得了最好的AUPRC(0.582)和AUROC(0.675),领先于BiLSTM+Attention(0.562 AUPRC)和ICCL(0.668 AUROC). 相对于哈维的内地训练,它只损失了0.038 AUPRC,而拥有最大内地飓风AUPRC和AUROC的BERT则损失了0.118 (0.626至0.508). 几个基线在此转变下向单一类别倾斜:BERT、DAPrompt、iLIF和RCE恢复的因果对数不到9%,而ANM、DECI和CHEER则将几乎所有对数标注为因果对数。

blocks.en: The reverse direction is substantially harder for STAGE: Hurricane-to-Wildfire transfer yields AUPRC 0.500 and AUROC 0.702, with AUPRC falling by 0.328 relative to in-domain Wildfire training, while several baselines transfer more effectively. Hurricane has a denser event stream, a more class-imbalanced weak-training split, and lower Weak–Gold agreement ( κ = 0.255 \kappa=0.255 versus 0.490 0.490 ), while STAGE also operates conservatively after transfer (recall 0.329 0.329 ). Because several baselines trained on the same supervision transfer better, the asymmetry may also reflect STAGE’s dataset-specific context features. Its temporal and spatial encodings contain absolute calendar fields and coordinates, which shift substantially across disasters occurring in different months and regions. Relative temporal and spatial representations may therefore improve cross-disaster transfer.
blocks.zh: 对STAGE来说,反向方向要困难得多:飓风到Wildfire的转移产生AUPRC 0.500和AUROC 0.702,与域内野火训练相比,AUPRC下降0.328,而几个基线的转移则更有效. 飓风有更密集的事件溪流,较分级平衡的弱训练分流,而下级弱-金协议(ob = 0.255\kappa= 0.255相较于0.490 0.490相较),而STAGE在转移后也有保守操作(回顾0.329 0.329). 由于在同一个监督转移方面训练有素的几个基线,不对称还可能反映STAGE数据集特有的上下文特征。 它的时间和空间编码包含绝对的日历域和坐标,它们在不同月份和不同区域发生的灾害之间发生了很大变化。 因此,相对的时间和空间分布可能改善跨灾害转移。

blocks.en: V-D Ablation Study
blocks.zh: V-D 读取研究

blocks.en: The ablations reveal different component contributions across the two disasters (Table V ). On Wildfire, removing semantic expansion causes the largest degradation ( − 0.025 -0.025 AUPRC, − 0.020 -0.020 AUROC), while removing GAT message passing has a smaller effect ( − 0.009 -0.009 , − 0.005 -0.005 ). On Hurricane, the pattern reverses: removing GAT produces the largest degradation ( − 0.014 -0.014 AUPRC, − 0.021 -0.021 AUROC), while other removals change AUPRC by at most 0.004. Overall, the results suggest that semantic enrichment and relational message passing contribute differently across disasters, while the full model achieves the highest mean AUPRC and AUROC.
blocks.zh: 这两次灾害的成份不同(表五)。 在野火上,去除语义膨胀引起最大的退化(-0.025-0.025 AUPRC,-0.020-0.020 AUROC),而去除GAT消息传递的影响较小(-0.009-0.009,-0.005-0.005). 在飓风上,规律倒转:去除GAT产生最大的退化(-0.014-0.014 AUPRC,-0.021-0.021 AUROC),而其他去除则使AUPRC改变最多为0.004. 总体而言,结果表明,语义丰富和关系信息传递在灾害中的贡献不同,而完整的模式实现了最高的中位数AUPRC和AUROC。

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en: This paper introduced STAGE, a framework for cross-tweet causal discovery that combines scalable weak-supervision construction with spatio-temporal relational learning. The results show that the constructed cross-tweet supervision substantially improves over local-only supervision and also benefits supervised baselines, while STAGE provides one effective relational instantiation for learning from this supervision. The results also reveal limitations: weak-label quality varies across disasters, and cross-disaster transfer remains sensitive to dataset shift and absolute spatio-temporal representations. Overall, STAGE provides a scalable approach to learning causal relations across fragmented disaster reports. Future work will focus on more transferable spatio-temporal representations and on calibrating cross-disaster weak supervision to shifts in causal prevalence and weak-label reliability.
blocks.zh: 本文引入了STAGE,是将可伸缩的弱超能构建与斯皮提奥-时空关系学习相结合的跨拓扑因子发现的框架. 结果显示,已建成的交叉式监督大大改进了仅在当地进行的监督,并惠及监督基线,而STAGE则为从这种监督中学习提供一种有效的关系即时分析。 结果也暴露出一些局限性:各种灾害的标签质量不尽相同,跨灾害转移仍然对数据集变化和绝对时空表现敏感。 总体而言,STAGE提供了一个可扩展的方法,用以在零散的灾害报告中学习因果关系。 今后的工作将侧重于更多的可转移的时空表述,并侧重于将跨灾害的薄弱监督调整到因果普遍程度和标签可靠性的转变。
